title: Nest box from one plank
summary: pick the bird, saw the plank
description: A nest box for a garden bird of the Low Countries, sawn from one plank and screwed: pick the species and the entrance, floor, height and even the shape of the box follow Vogelbescherming Nederland's table.
process: Sawing and screwing (one plank), hand-cut zinc

difficulty.rationale: Table-driven topology: terrace with end-wall entrances, fixed or pivoted front, formula-driven plank plan.

standards: Vogelbescherming Nederland: Nestkasten in soorten en maten (inside sizes per species, 2018)
Avon Wildlife Trust, Basically Boxes part 1: hole at least 125 mm above the floor, wood at least 15 mm, no perch, liftable lid or panel, vertical grain
materials: Untreated European larch plank, 15 to 25 mm thick
Zinc sheet, 0.8 mm (roof strip and predator guard)
